text:
taylor (AE): Looping in SE and solutions — ACME security team asked about SAML + SCIM details for the POC. @mike can you confirm which IdP (Okta/Azure/Ping)? Also need to know if they require domain ownership controls or org-affiliated email only. Timeline: try to spin up staging next week.

mike (ACME-IT): They're on Azure AD. They want SCIM provisioning + AD group -> RBAC mapping. Also asked if Hosted can restrict signups by domain; they don't want public signups.

rahul (SE): Hosted supports domain allowlist + invite-only org creation. SCIM v2 supported with bulk sync and group->role mapping. For strict tenancy/compliance they might prefer Dedicated/Private, but lots of customers use Hosted + SCIM + domain allowlist for POC.

sara (CISO): To confirm process: should we send them our security questionnaire or will they provide theirs? Need our standard answers for: SAML attributes, SCIM rate limits & filtering, provisioning logs, data-at-rest encryption, and SCIM change audit trails.

emma (Solutions): I'll pull together a short matrix and sample SAML metadata/attribute mapping. We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. Example attributes we expect: email, firstName, lastName, groups, roles.

emma (Solutions): Sample SAML snippet we usually share:
```
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="email">
    <saml:AttributeValue>${user.email}</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
  <saml:Attribute Name="groups">
    <saml:AttributeValue>${user.groups}</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```

rahul (SE): SCIM notes for the POC: we support /Users and /Groups endpoints, group filtering, and bulk operations. Typical provisioning latency for a bulk sync ~30-90s. Hosted rate limits: 600 req/min/org (documented); Dedicated can be configured higher. Nested groups are not expanded server-side by default.

mike (ACME-IT): They also want RBAC examples — mapping AD group 'Redwood_Admins' -> org.admin. Can you confirm support for nested group expansion?

rahul (SE): We don't expand nested groups automatically. Options: flatten on the IdP side, use a transform rule in Azure, or pre-flatten in SCIM payload. For the POC we can accept pre-flattened groups from your side.

taylor (AE): Pricing question flagged by procurement: if they require Dedicated for compliance, what's the ballpark? Also what's the delta to enable longer audit retention and SIEM webhooks?

emma (Solutions): Dedicated is contracted (monthly/annual commit) — baseline Dedicated packages typically start in the low-mid five figures / month depending on GPU capacity and SLA. Audit retention and SIEM integration are add-ons; webhooks/log-forwarding available on Dedicated/Private. Hosted supports exports and short-term retention; extended retention is a paid add-on. I'll pull a concrete quote.

sara (CISO): They require 13 months audit log retention, session idle timeout controls, and SAML cert rotation process documented. Also want SOC 2 Type II and ISO status.

taylor (AE): We have SOC 2 Type II. ISO is in progress. Data residency: EU-hosted region available; Private for on-prem/on-network. I'll attach SOC2 once NDA is in place.

rahul (SE): For SAML cert rollover we support metadata refresh and recommend configuring key rollover with overlapping certs to avoid downtime. We'll provide a step-by-step rotation guide for the customer. For SCIM logs we keep audit trail of provisioning events; exportable via API for Dedicated/Private, on Hosted we provide downloadable exports and can schedule longer retention with the add-on.

emma (Solutions): Action items: @mike please send IdP metadata (metadata.xml), a sample AD group list, and a short list of user emails to seed the POC. We'll: 1) exchange metadata 2) enable SCIM on a staging tenant 3) sync groups 4) verify role mapping 5) test SP + IdP login flows and cert rollover.

mike (ACME-IT): :thumbsup: I'll send metadata and groups today. Any immediate blockers from security?

sara (CISO): Need confirmation on SCIM rate limits, cert rotation SLA, and if audit log exports include SAML assertion IDs and timestamps. Also want to see our security questionnaire completed before the POC kickoff.

rahul (SE): Rate limits: Hosted default = 600 req/min/org. For POC scale this is fine, but we'll note this in the matrix. SCIM logs include event, actor, timestamp, and deltas; SAML assertion logging includes assertion ID and timestamp for authentication events.

taylor (AE): Target: have staging POC ready within 5 business days after we receive metadata. I'll do a follow-up with procurement on Dedicated pricing if they escalate. Ping me directly for anything blocking.

emma (Solutions): I'll draft the short matrix and the SAML + SCIM quickstart guide and post it here when ready.

mike (ACME-IT): Thanks all — sending files shortly.

taylor (AE): Thanks — will re-open thread if questions come up.
